column1: # Partition table for 16MB-flash boards WITHOUT ESP-SR (no speech recognition)
# Used by 16MB-flash boards (e.g. FeatherS3[D]) selected via HW_BOARD.
# No "model" partition — all the extra 8MB (vs the 8MB layout) goes to LittleFS.
# Factory:  4948K (0x4D5000)  — same size as the 8MB layout so an app binary
#                                built for either fits in either partition map.
